hypothesis: A single authoritative epoch-sealed semantic store plus rebuildable epoch-bound associative sidecars can improve hot-path latency and state consistency over split authoritative stores without accepting the common-mode failure radius of universal physical consolidation.
counterhypothesis: Physical consolidation or PostgreSQL+pgvector may dominate once target concurrency/vector scale/recovery costs are measured; the hybrid may add stale-index complexity without enough benefit.
external_delta: SQLite 2026 WAL-reset bug makes exact runtime version a correctness gate.
